title: Earliest Egyptian hieroglyphs
summary: Early glyphs from Abydos may point to Egyptian writing developing independently of Mesopotamia. Scholars have not settled the question.
why: Writing in Egypt, possibly one of the independent inventions of writing.

notes.problem: dateLabel says c. 3400-3200 BCE (source: Abydos glyphs 'dated between 3400 and 3200 BC') but yearEnd is null.
